item: Market.json written after the Market event

current_value_in_wfmt: the station docked at when the mission was accepted
source: Real CargoDepot and MissionAccepted journal events, 2025-2026 (game facts)

source_license: Game data from the owner's own play

Checked 2026-10-23 against the owner's journals: every JetConeBoost event under the Mk II overcharge drive reads 6.0 at a neutron star (618 events) and 3.0 at a white dwarf (295), and every one under another drive reads 4.0 (135) or 1.5 (252). Bump to 'Verified - in game' once the boosted range is compared in the game.

item: Route Planner: frame shift drive base values
what_to_check: That each drive's optimal mass, maximum fuel per jump, fuel multiplier and fuel power in fsd_data.FSD, and the Guardian booster ranges, are the game's
current_value_in_wfmt: 66 drives and 5 boosters, copied from the Coriolis data as Spansh's page carries it (read 2026-10-18)
source: Spansh's exact plotter page and the owner's own ship
source_license: Game facts; Coriolis data declares no license (credited in ATTRIBUTIONS)
how_to_verify_in_game: Compare a few drives (an engineered and an unengineered one, a class 5 and a class 8) with the outfitting screen and the ship's statistics panel: optimal mass and maximum fuel per jump.
notes: Added 2026-10-18 with the Route Planner. Checked 2026-10-23 against Coriolis's drive file: all 66 drives match it (it lists one extra, the 'missing' placeholder). The only difference is Size 5 Class 5 SCO, whose second Coriolis entry (a 'PreEng V1' variant with the same symbol) reads fuel multiplier 0.012 against 0.013 for the first; 0.013 is WFMT's, matches the other class 5 SCO drives, and gives a median ratio of 1.000 of actual to predicted FuelUsed over 4,867 recorded jumps of one ship. The same formula (base multiplier and power) reproduces FuelUsed to within 0.01% in median for the Size 2, 3, 4, 5 and 7 Class 5 SCO drives, the Size 8 Mk II drive and Size 5 Class 1 and 2 drives, using Loadout's engineered optimal mass and the fuel carried (cargo ignored). Several other ships' medians are off (a ship swapped without a new Loadout, cargo, a drive with an experimental effect); those are not explained. Optimal mass and maximum fuel of unengineered drives still need the outfitting screen.

item: Rare goods: where each of the 13 restricted rares is illegal
